_doc: Snapshot of the two module contracts the library may reference. The library gate (scripts/camera-library/library.mjs) accepts an `access` entry `bridge:<protocol>` only when <protocol> is listed under bridge.protocols, and an `activationDriver` only when it is listed under activator.drivers. `node scripts/camera-library/build.mjs --check` also compares this file with the sibling checkouts (../h2z.bridge/protocols.json, ../h2z.activator/src/drivers) when they exist, so a contract change that is not copied here is reported. Whether a module is installed and implements an entry is decided at run time from its /v1/capabilities, not here.
